description: This Python source file defines utility functions for generating C++ code and build configurations related to AOTInductor models in a PyTorch project. It includes functions to produce a C++ main file for model execution and a CMakeLists.txt file for building the project, with support for CUDA/hip and multiple models.

methods.name: str _get_main_cpp_file( package_name: str, model_names: list[str], cuda: bool, example_inputs_map: dict[str, int] | None, is_hip: bool, )
methods.description: Generates the content of a main.cpp file to load, run, and optionally validate AOTInductor models with optional example inputs, supporting CUDA or HIP.

methods.name: str _get_make_file( package_name: str, model_names: list[str], cuda: bool, is_hip: bool )
methods.description: Creates the content of a CMakeLists.txt file for building the AOTInductor models project, including CUDA/hip support and linking necessary libraries.
